{{Top|leg}}
A '''Trade Representative''' was a [[Nalroni/Legends|Nalroni]] official whose sole purpose was to warn [[free-trader]]s and [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] of the hazards of [[Celanon City]], and ensuring that they had taken adequate security measures in the form of paying the Trade Representative a fee so that their business would go unhindered. The fee was based on the number of visits made by the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] to [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]], whether or not the crew were known to traffic in illegal cargo, and how much the Trade Representative believed he could extract at the time.
